newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bank Austria source says CA reports "not wrong".
newsitem.headline: Bank Austria source says CA reports "not wrong".

text.p: Austrian media reports that Bank Austria is considering a bid for its closest rival Creditanstalt-Bankverein are "not wrong", a source close to Bank Austria's supervisory board said on Wednesday.
"The headlines are not wrong," the source told Reuters.

Austrian tabloid daily Neue Kronen Zeitung reported on Wednesday that Bank Austria was ready to pay 16 billion schillings ($1.5 billion) for the state's 70 percent of Creditanstalt ordinary voting shares. ($ = 10.86 Austrian Schillings)
"Where an Austrian solution is sought (by the government) and it is possible financially, a management that did get involved would be making a mistake," the source said.
Bank Austria's supervisory board will meet later today. The source said outside investments would figure on the agenda.
Bank Austria has refused to make any official comment.
The stock exchange earlier suspended trade in Bank Austria shares and participation certificates pending an important announcement.
